changes: The detail-library toolbar now fully covers scrolling cards at its sticky header boundary, including the side gutters.
Switching between DMG and GBC while paused immediately redraws the selected hardware without advancing or resuming emulation.
Console and screen-only views now transition with a quick zoom before replaying the cartridge insertion animation.
The cataloguing wireframe now recedes with the paint line so stray outline pixels cannot protrude above the finished cartridge.
